detail.longDescription:
Safe Cleaner Antivirus is a simple utility app designed to help you check your device, browse storage, and clean unnecessary junk files with clear and easy-to-use tools.

The app provides a straightforward experience for users who want to manage device storage and run basic security scans without complicated steps. You can open Safe Cleaner Antivirus, start a virus scan, review scan results, check storage usage, and use cleanup tools from a clean interface.

Main features:

Safe Cleaner
Access the main tools for device checking, storage review, and cleanup in one place.

Virus scan
Run a scan on your device and review detected risks shown by the app. The scan result page helps you understand what was found and take action based on the available options.

Storage Browser
View your device storage usage and browse storage categories such as images, videos, audio files, documents, and zip files. This makes it easier to understand what is using space on your device.

Junk Clean
Find and clean unnecessary junk files to help keep your storage more organized.

Safe Cleaner Antivirus focuses on simple device cleanup, storage browsing, and scan tools. It is built for users who want a cleaner, easier way to check storage and manage unwanted files.
